faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about training, pricing, and deployment.

q1.q: How does the 3-Day Free Trial work?
q1.a: You get full access to build and test your AI Agent for 3 days without entering a credit card. Upgrade whenever you are ready.

q2.q: How do I train the AI Sales Agent on my products?
q2.a: Simply upload your catalog files (PDF, Word, Excel), paste your website link, or type Q&A pairs. The AI learns your products instantly.

q3.q: Can the AI automatically take product orders?
q3.a: Yes! The AI agent collects customer shipping info, phone number, and items, creating an organized order list in your dashboard.

q4.q: Which social media channels can I connect?
q4.a: You can connect Facebook Page, WhatsApp Business, Instagram Direct, Telegram, TikTok, and embed it on your website.

q5.q: Can a human agent take over if the AI gets stuck?
q5.a: Absolutely! The system alerts your team and allows instant Live Chat human takeover at any time.
